source.name: San Francisco 49ers - San Francisco 49ers and U.S. Bank Announce Multiyear Partnership Extension
source.quote: The new multiyear deal strengthens the 49ers-U.S. Bank relationship, which began in 2014, and adds a new practice jersey patch.

note: Practice-jersey patch. Announced 2026-08-12; also confirmed by Sports Business Journal, 2026-09-10 (https://www.sportsbusinessjournal.com/Articles/2026/09/10/health-care-providers-financial-companies-dominate-nfl-jersey-patches/): "U.S. Bank, a commercial partner of the 49ers since 2014, is now on the team's jersey. The club had no sponsor last season."
